evals.prompt: Review my current work-in-progress changes against main. HEAD has no new commits, but I have staged, unstaged, and untracked source files.
evals.expected_output: Reviews all three working-tree change classes alongside the committed diff instead of reporting an empty diff.
expectations: Resolves the fixed point and captures the committed, staged, and unstaged diffs
Includes relevant untracked-file contents in both Standards and Spec axes
Does not stage or commit files merely to review them
Keeps Standards and Spec findings separate

evals.prompt: You are an unattended Orca Reviewer. Review ticket ITEM-240 from base SHA B to clean reviewed head H using the supplied tracker spec.
evals.expected_output: Reviews the pinned committed comparison, using the supplied spec and separate Standards and Spec axes without seeking a user-supplied fixed point.
expectations: Uses the Task's fixed point, reviewed head, and spec
Does not request user input in the Reviewer terminal
Remains read-only and reports findings to the owning Coordinator
